newsitem.title: USA: CTIG hopes acquisition will boost revs.
newsitem.headline: CTIG hopes acquisition will boost revs.

text.p: CTI Group (Holdings) Inc said Tuesday that it has entered a memorandum of understanding to acquire the assets of an international telecom software business.

The pact is subject to completion of a definitive agreement and securing the necessary financing, but if completed, the deal would triple CTIG's annual revenues from about $3.9 million to $11.3 million, CTIG said.
The company said revenues could reach as much as $24 million within two years.

CTIG, which designs, develops, markets and supports information processing software and services for telecommunications systems, did not name the company it is seeking to acquire nor provide financial terms of the deal.
CTIG said it and its targeted acquisition both recently introduced new, Year-2000 compliant, Windows OS products for sale and are seeking to expand distribution channels into new markets.
The company said it has appointed Colmen Capital Advisors Inc of King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, to facilitate the transaction.
